name: BioNixus Healthcare Market Research Overview
description: A short overview of how BioNixus designs quantitative, qualitative, and access programs for pharmaceutical teams in global markets including the Americas, Europe, and the Middle East.
transcript:
BioNixus supports pharmaceutical and healthcare teams with market research built for real decisions — launch readiness, market access, payer evidence, and competitive intelligence.

This overview explains how BioNixus scopes quantitative physician and payer studies, qualitative KOL and advisory work, and market-access modules when a brand must choose between syndicated data and custom primary fieldwork. Programs are led by senior researchers who align instruments to regulator context — SFDA and NUPCO in Saudi Arabia, MOHAP/DHA/DOH in the UAE, EMA and national HTA bodies in Europe, and FDA/CMS dynamics in the United States — rather than exporting a single global questionnaire.

Typical deliverables include feasibility memos, bilingual screeners, committee-ready executive readouts, and action plans tied to a named commercial gate (pricing corridor, tender strategy, launch sequencing, or competitive defence). BioNixus fields work from offices and partner networks in the GCC, Egypt, the United Kingdom, and Brazil, with harmonised Arabic–English QC on waves that span multiple countries.

Teams comparing IQVIA or other syndicated vendors use BioNixus when they need verified HCP and payer voices, not another data licence. Engagement sizes for standalone primary healthcare research generally start around USD 20,000, with proposal turnaround in about 48 hours once objectives and geographies are clear.

To request a scoped proposal or see anonymized case studies, use the contact form on bionixus.com or email hello@bionixus.com.

name: BioNixus Consumer & B2B Market Research
description: See how BioNixus designs and delivers consumer and B2B research programmes across MENA, Africa, and Europe for healthcare and pharmaceutical decision-makers.
transcript:
BioNixus is a global market research firm serving pharmaceutical, healthcare, and consumer brands. This video introduces how consumer and B2B programmes are designed when the buyer is a marketing, strategy, or insights lead rather than a clinical development team.

Consumer health, OTC, retail pharmacy, financial services, telecom, and B2B technology categories each need different sampling frames — shopper missions, corporate procurement committees, or digital product owners — but the same governance standard: verified respondents, documented QC, and deliverables mapped to a revenue or share decision.

BioNixus combines regional fieldwork depth across MENA, Africa, and Europe with senior analyst synthesis so findings are activation-ready. Mixed-mode designs (online quant, CATI, in-person depth, mystery shopping) can sit inside one programme when a launch spans both hospital and retail channels.

Pharmaceutical clients often pair this Track B consumer work with healthcare primary research on the BioNixus services hub. Cross-links to healthcare market research, case studies, and the consumer market research portal are listed below the player on this page.

For a scoped proposal, visit bionixus.com/contact or email hello@bionixus.com.
